method: Local synthetic RoomStore + broker with active 1/30/100 rooms; one host lease renewal. Elapsed time is a single local sample, not production latency.
directRegression: A valid tennis swing held in the TV message queue for 180ms was previously dropped by the 160ms age check. New tests deliver it once; 251ms and future-clock inputs are rejected and acknowledged as expired.
pollingRegression: Original reproduction: a real Socket.IO polling POST delayed by 120 ms for optional lease traffic made a fresh swing expire under the former 80 ms limit. Optional direct negotiation is now suspended on polling and resumes on WebSocket upgrade. The final regression uses a 200 ms optional POST to verify it cannot consume the new shared budget.
limits: Real direct RTC delivery remains unverified under enforced browser policy
Local socket timing is not Seattle/Railway or physical motion-to-screen latency

initialFullSuite.parallelWork: Vitest and compile were also running

pollingHandoffDiagnosis.finding: No usable server-to-TV polling slot existed before the former 80 ms wait deadline. A queued state acknowledgement and lobby snapshot consumed earlier GETs. This was an actual polling handoff timeout, not a missed writable edge. Resource contention alone did not explain the repeated failures.

fix.omittedMetadata: Older senders use zero declared phone wait; server wait never exceeds 160 ms
fix.invalidMetadata: Protocol rejects nonfinite, negative or greater-than-160 values; remaining-budget helper also fails closed
guarantees: At most one waiting action per socket
Expired actions are not buffered or replayed
Pause and session-generation changes invalidate waiting input

pollingHandoffDiagnosis.scope: The shared cap covers application transport queue waits. It does not measure or cap network transit, motion recognition, rendering, or total input-to-display time.

controlledRealPollingChecks: A 120 ms TV GET handoff delivers the fresh swing exactly once
A 200 ms optional lease POST cannot block the normal relay because direct negotiation is suspended on polling
